services.title: Tool Design & Engineering
services.description: Comprehensive tooling and fixture engineering for manufacturing operations. From concept sketches to detailed manufacturing drawings, we deliver production-ready tool designs.
services.details: Our tool design process follows a structured methodology: requirement analysis, concept development, detailed design with 3D CAD, FEA validation, and complete manufacturing documentation. Every design is reviewed against manufacturing feasibility and operator ergonomics.

services.title: CAD & Technical Drafting
services.description: Advanced 3D modeling and 2D technical drawing creation using industry-standard software platforms.
services.details: We work with CATIA V5, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Creo to deliver precision models and drawings. Our drafting standards comply with IS, ASME, and ISO specifications. Every drawing includes complete GD&T annotations.

services.title: Design Optimization
services.description: Improving efficiency, structural integrity, and cost-effectiveness of existing designs through engineering analysis.
services.details: Using FEA simulation and decades of manufacturing experience, we identify opportunities to reduce weight, improve strength-to-weight ratios, and optimize material usage without compromising functional requirements.

services.title: Reverse Engineering
services.description: Accurate digital reconstruction of physical parts and assemblies for documentation, modification, or reproduction.
services.details: We convert physical parts into accurate 3D CAD models through measurement, scanning, and engineering analysis. Ideal for legacy parts without documentation, design modification of existing products, and quality verification.

projects.title: Wing Structure Assembly Jig Design
projects.description: High-precision assembly jig designed to meet HAL aerospace standards for fighter aircraft wing assembly. Involved complex multi-axis positioning, automated clamping sequences, and comprehensive manufacturing documentation package.
projects.challenge: Achieve ±0.05mm positional accuracy across a 12-meter span while accommodating thermal expansion and structural deflection during assembly operations.
projects.solution: Designed a modular jig system with FEA-validated structural members, precision-ground locating surfaces, and temperature-compensating adjustment mechanisms.

projects.title: BIW Welding Fixture
projects.description: Body-in-white welding fixture for high-volume automotive production line. Designed for robotic MIG welding with automated clamping and part loading/unloading.
projects.challenge: Design a fixture supporting 60-second cycle time with 47 weld points while maintaining ±0.3mm body panel alignment.
projects.solution: Pneumatic toggle clamp system with sequence-controlled actuation, integrated copper backup bars, and modular nest design for variant management.

projects.title: Skin Contour Profile Control System
projects.description: Advanced checking fixture for aerospace skin contour verification. Enables precise measurement of complex double-curved surfaces against master CAD geometry.
projects.challenge: Verify compound-curved aluminum skin panels with profile tolerances of 0.5mm across surfaces up to 3 meters.
projects.solution: Custom contour template system with adjustable probe points, datum reference frame, and digital indicator integration for quantitative measurement.

projects.title: Engine Mount Machining Fixture
projects.description: 5-axis CNC machining fixture for engine mounting brackets. Designed for multi-operation machining in a single setup to minimize datum errors.
projects.challenge: Machine 6 critical features in a single setup with true position tolerance of 0.02mm on a cast aluminum part with irregular clamping surfaces.
projects.solution: Hydraulic workholding system with conformal nest design, through-tool coolant passages, and vacuum-assisted part seating verification.

projects.title: Fuselage Panel Assembly Tooling
projects.description: Complete tooling package for helicopter fuselage panel sub-assembly. Includes drilling jigs, assembly fixtures, and inspection gauges.
projects.challenge: Deliver an integrated tooling package supporting 23 unique panel configurations with shared datum architecture.
projects.solution: Modular tooling platform with interchangeable locating modules, drill bushings, and self-aligning master gauges for each panel variant.

projects.title: Progressive Die for Bracket Stamping
projects.description: 12-station progressive die for high-volume bracket production. Designed for 250T mechanical press with automatic strip feeding.
projects.challenge: Produce a complex bracket with 4 bends and 8 piercing operations at 40 strokes per minute with ±0.1mm dimensional accuracy.
projects.solution: Optimized strip layout with 87% material utilization, guided strippers, carbide inserts at wear points, and spring-loaded pilots for precise registration.

story.heading: Engineering Excellence Since 2015
story.content: DAVS Integrated Engineering Solutions was founded with a singular vision: to bridge the gap between design intent and manufacturing reality. Starting as a small team of passionate mechanical engineers, we have grown into a trusted partner for OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and aerospace organizations across India.

faqs.question: What industries do you serve?
faqs.answer: We serve aerospace, automotive, heavy engineering, general manufacturing, and defense sectors. Our tooling designs meet standards from HAL, ISRO, and major automotive OEMs.

faqs.question: What CAD software do you use?
faqs.answer: Our primary platforms are CATIA V5, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD. We also work with Creo (Pro/E) and can deliver in STEP, IGES, or native formats as required.

faqs.question: What is your typical project turnaround time?
faqs.answer: Simple fixtures: 2-3 weeks. Complex assembly jigs: 4-8 weeks. Aerospace tooling with full documentation: 8-12 weeks. Rush projects can be accommodated — please contact us for specific timelines.

faqs.question: Do you provide manufacturing support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide complete manufacturing documentation including 2D drawings, BOMs, assembly instructions, and can coordinate with your manufacturing partners during fabrication.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing designs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We regularly perform design modifications, optimization of existing fixtures, and conversion of legacy drawings to 3D CAD models.

faqs.question: What quality standards do you follow?
faqs.answer: Our processes comply with ISO 9001:2015. For aerospace projects, we follow AS9100D and HAL-specific design standards. All drawings include complete GD&T per ASME Y14.5.
